sola.definition:
a. See Solus.
n. A leguminous plant (Aeschynomene aspera) growing in moist
   places in Southern India and the East Indies. Its pithlike stem is used
   for making hats, swimming-jackets, etc.
fem. a. Alone; -- chiefly used in stage directions, and the
   like.

sola topi.translation: n. （用粗糙田皂角木髓制的）遮阳帽

solace.definition: n. comfort in disappointment or misery
solace.translation:
n. 安慰, 安慰之物
vt. 安慰, 抚慰, 给与安慰, 使轻松

solaced.translation: v. 安慰, 慰藉( solace的过去分词 )

solaceful.translation: a. 充满慰藉的,带来安慰的

solacement.definition:
n. The act of solacing, or the state of being solaced;

solacement.translation: n. 安慰；慰藉；安慰之物 (solace的变形)

solacer.translation: n. 安慰；慰藉；安慰之物 (solace的变形)

solaces.definition:
n the comfort you feel when consoled in times of disappointment
n comfort in disappointment or misery
n the act of consoling; giving relief in affliction

solacet.translation: n. 索勒赛特(偶氮染料的专利商标名)

solan.definition: n very large white gannet with black wing tips

solanaceae.definition: n large and economically important family of herbs or shrubs or trees often strongly scented and sometimes narcotic or poisonous; includes the genera Solanum, Atropa, Brugmansia, Capsicum, Datura, Hyoscyamus, Lycopersicon, Nicotiana, Petunia, Physalis, and Solandra

solanaceous.definition: a of or relating to plants of the family Solanaceae (the potato family)

solanaceous vegetable.translation: 茄子科蔬菜; 茄类蔬菜

solander.translation: n. 索兰德盒(一种放文件、标本等的书状盒)

solanidine.definition:
n. An alkaloid produced by the decomposition of solanine,
   as a white crystalline substance having a harsh bitter taste.
solanidine.translation:
[化] 茄啶
[医] 茄啶(茄硷的水解产物)

solanine.definition:
n. A poisonous alkaloid glucoside extracted from the berries
   of common nightshade (Solanum nigrum), and of bittersweet, and from
   potato sprouts, as a white crystalline substance having an acrid,
   burning taste; -- called also solonia, and solanina.

solanism.translation: [医] 茄硷中毒, 龙葵硷中毒

solano.definition:
A hot, oppressive wind which sometimes blows in the
   Mediterranean, particularly on the eastern coast of Spain.
solano.translation: n. [气]沙拉拿风( 西班牙东南海岸夏季的一种东风)

solanoid.definition: a. Resembling a potato; -- said of a kind of cancer.
